 TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 These terms and conditions shall be read in conjunction with the General Expo Terms and the General Terms (collectively, “ Expo Terms and Conditions ”). The Expo Terms and Conditions shall govern the relationship between the Exhibitor and Zameen in respect of the Expo. 
 On the Exhibitor's request and by virtue of this Agreement, the Stall(s) have been booked for the Exhibitor for Zameen's Expo at the Venue . 
 The Exhibitor represents and confirms that it has read the Expo Terms and Conditions and, by signing this Agreement, undertakes to strictly comply with them dur ing the validity of this Agreement. 
 This Agreement shall be effective from the date of signing of this A greement and shall expire on the date on which all payments under this Agreement have been paid in full and any and all other obligations have been discharged by the Exhibitor to the satisfaction of Zameen. 
 The Exhibitor undertakes and agrees to strictly adhere to Zameen's branding guidelines, fabrication requirements and stall specifications for the Expo provided in the Expo Terms and Conditions . 
 The Stall specifications, design and installation are subject to the following: 
 The height of a stall shall not exceed 12ft . 
 Zameen retains complete authority and control over all fabricated designs layouts and specifications. 
 All fabricated stall designs shall strictly adhere to Zameen's design layouts and the floor plan of the Expo Package seen and booked by the Exhibitor at the time of signing of this Agreement. No external design layout shall be permitted. 
 Exhibitor shall obtain approval from Zameen for fabricated stall design at least 30 (thirty) days prior to the Expo . Failure to obtain approval shall result in an unapproved stall being prohibited from installation at the Venue. In this event, any payment made by the Exhibitor under this Agreement shall be forfeited. 
 Fabricated stalls shall be prepared, branded, printed and installed at the Exhibitor's own cost. 
 Zameen will share a list of recommended vendors with the Exhibitor; however, Exhibitor is permitted to use a vendor of its own choice for the preparation, printing and installation of the stall. Zameen takes no responsibility of the work done or any act or omission on the part of the suggested vendor. 
 Fabricated stall structure, branding, printing, etc. must be ready for installation at least 48 (forty-eight) hours before the Expo, and the Exhibitor must report to the Venue at the time stipulated by Zameen for Stall installation. 
 Installation of stall must be complete at least 12 (twelve) hours prior to the opening/start of Expo. Installation during the Expo is strictly prohibited. Incomplete stalls will not be permitted to open during the Expo. Exhibitor must report to the Venue at least 2 (two) hours before the opening /start time of the Expo. 
 Exhibitor shall ensure that the passages adjacent or connected to its Stall, entrance to its own Stall or other adjacent stall s to its stall remain unhindered at all times. 
 Zameen reserves the right to remove, confiscate or relocate, without prior notice to the Exhibitor, any of the Exhibitor’s branding and/or marketing material at Zameen’s sole discretion where such material is inappropriate, does not conform to Expo Terms and Conditions or the b randing g uidelines provided by Zameen . The Exhibitor shall be fully responsible for any and all administrative costs incurred by Zameen and for any loss or damage(s) whether direct or indirect or consequential for and/or during such removal, confiscation and/or relocation. 
 The Exhibitor shall not assign or sub-let the Stall(s) to any other person or entity. However, Zameen may assign this Agreement or any of its rights or obligations here under . 
 In the event that a fabricated stall is prohibited at the Venue under Clause 5(d) above, Zameen may, at its sole discretion and subject to availability , offer the Exhibitor a shell scheme stall as an alternative. However, the Total Consideration shall not be revised, no payment shall be refunded and the Exhibitor will be strictly liable to pay any R emaining Amount towards the Total Consideration under this Agreement. 
 Zameen is only responsible for arranging the Expo and Booking of the Stall(s). Zameen shall not be responsible for making , and does not guarantee that, the Expo a success, generation of any leads or business opportunities or for the number of visitors, potential customers or clients at the Venue on the Expo dates. The Venue of the Expo is neither owned nor controlled by Zameen. Zameen is not responsible for any facility( ie s )/service(s) at the Venue and in the event of failure of any facility( ie s )/service(s) at the Venue, Zameen shall not be liable for any loss or damage whether direct or indirect or consequential. 
 The Exhibitor undertakes to strictly follow the rules and regulations of the Venue. Exhibitor's failure to follow the aforesaid rules and regulations shall be deemed to be a material breach of this Agreement. 
 The Total Consideration is net of all the taxes, withholdings applicable on the same and the payment of all such taxes and withholdings shall be the responsibility of the Exhibitor . 
 In the event of payment delay by the Exhibitor under this Agreement, Zameen may grant an extension to the Exhibitor with a late payment surcharge of 5% (five percent) of the Remaining Amount per 10 (ten) days of delay in payment. 
 The E xhibitor understands, acknowledges and agrees that any payments made under this A greement are non-adjustable and/or non-refundable unless explicitly provided under this A greement and any rights created and /or assigned under this A greement to the E xhibitor are non-transferrable to any other individual or entity . 
 The Exhibitor undertakes and represents that it shall not perform any of the Prohibited Activ iti es , as provided in the General Expo Terms, before or during the Expo, including inter alia carrying a weapon, using a sound system for music or announcements or for any other purpose, use helium balloons, candles or any other flammable material at the stall or the Venue. Prohibited Activities shall, at all times, also include aiding the commission thereof. 
 The Exhibitor acknowledges and agrees that Zameen shall not be liable for any damage (including but not limited to direct damage, indirect damage, loss of profits/business or consequential damage) suffered by the Exhibitor in case Zameen is in breach of any term hereof or for any other reason. In case liability cannot be excluded under the law as aforesaid, any liability of Zameen shall be limited to the amount paid by the Exhibitor under this Agreement to a maximum of the Total Consideration. 
 The Exhibitor undertakes full responsibility and liability for the actions of its employees, agents, independent contractors, and volunteers, and agrees to indemnify, hold harmless, and defend Zameen , its affiliated companies and each of its respective officers, directors, partners, agents, representatives, employees, and volunteers (collectively, the “ Indemnified Parts ”) from and against all liabilities, obligations, claims, damages, penalties, causes of action, costs and expenses (including without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees and expenses) imposed upon or incurred by or asserted against any of the Indemnified Parts relating to the Expo by reason of any acts, negligent or otherwise, or omissions of its employees, agents, independent contractors, and volunteers whether acting within or without the scope of their authority; and any failure on the part of the Exhibitor to perform or comply with any of the provisions of Expo Terms and Conditions or violation of any Federal, Provincial, local, municipal or any other law or regulation for the time being in force . 
 In the event of Force Majeure, neither party shall be deemed to be in breach of this Agreement, or otherwise be liable to the other, by reason of any delay in performance, partial performance or non-performance, of any of its obligations under this Agreement to the extent that such delay or non-performance or partial performance is due to any Force Majeure event of which it has notified the other party; and the time for performance of that obligation shall be extended accordingly , force majeure even is resulting from acts of God (including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, storm, hurricane or other natural disasters), war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, hostilities (regardless of whether war is declared), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, terrorist activities, nationalization, foreign policy changes, government sanction, blockage, embargo, labor dispute, strike, pandemic, lock down, lockout or interruption or failure of electricity or telephone service, or failure of the Event venue administration to offer services as agreed. 
 In the event, any provision (s) of the General Expo Terms is found to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable under the laws of any relevant jurisdiction, the invalid or unenforceable provision shall be given no effect but the remaining provisions of the General Expo Terms shall remain in full force and effect. 
 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the Expo Agreement or b ooking of the Stall shall firstly be resolved through mutual consultation failing which any concerned party may refer the matter for arbitration in Lahore to be regulated as per the provisions of the Arbitration Act, 1940 under the laws of Pakistan. 
 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Pakistan, and each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Lahore . 
 The Expo Terms and Conditions embody the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes any prior understanding and agreements between and among them with respect to the subject matter hereof . 
 In the event of any conflict between the terms and conditions of this Agreement, General Terms and the General Expo Terms, provisions of General Expo Terms shall prevail. 
 
 Termination 
 
 The Exhibitor understands and acknowledges that Zameen may, in its absolute discretion, cancel the booking of the Stall(s), without any prior written notice. In the event of such cancellation, subject to exceptions, this A greement shall stand terminated and Zameen shall refund all payments made by the Exhibitor under this Agreement. 
 By signing this Agreement, the Exhibitor undertakes to pay the Remaining Amount at least thirty (30) days prior to the date of the Expo. Any default therein may result in cancellation of booking and termination of this Agreement, and any payment made hereunder by the Exhibitor will be forfeited. 
 In the event of force majeure this A greement shall stand terminated and in case of such termination Zameen shall refund to the Exhibitor all payments received by Zameen in respect of the Expo under this A greement after deduction of any amount relating to any expenses incurred by Zameen. 
 In the event of termination of this Agreement by the Exhibitor for any reason , any payment received by Zameen from the Exhibitor under this Agreement shall stand forfeited. 
 In the event that the Exhibitor violates any of the covenants, agreements, or stipulations of the Expo Terms and Conditions, Zameen shall thereupon have the right to terminate this Agreement with immediate effect, and any payment(s) received by Zameen from the Exhibitor hereunder shall stand forfeited. 
 In the event that the E xpo V enue is not functional, operational or is closed on the date of the E xpo due to pandemic, lock down or for any other reason by the order any competent regulatory or government authority, Zameen shall refund full payment within a period of three (3) months from the scheduled date of the E xpo.
